lines.text: The root is Duc! Introduce, produce, reduce.
Did you know? Duc is Latin for lead.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus lead?

words.ex: Let me introduce you to my colleague.
This factory produces parts for bicycles.
We should reduce the amount of plastic we use.
